source_snapshot.procedure: Send in-band `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x25` on localhost and decode source-listed response Byte 2 Timer Use, Byte 3 Timer Actions, Byte 4 pre-timeout seconds and Byte 5 expiration flags.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without error.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES preserves raw 0x06/0x25 but uses unsafe sshpass/host-key bypass, displays high-level output and defers field judgment to a user.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE correctly extends parsing to the complete standard response, countdown and policy comparison without writes.

old_problem: The historical record retained Pending for target/schema, complete parsing and expected Project policy. IPMI section 27.7 fully defines the eight response payload bytes and units; pinned ipmitool confirms the field masks and little-endian countdown conversion. Target and expected policy are finite readiness inputs.
disposition_reason: Run raw 0x06/0x25 once on the verified localhost in-band path, require successful completion and exactly eight payload bytes, preserve every source-listed field, additionally decode the normative initial and present countdown words, and compare the complete state to the versioned Project watchdog policy. Surface running/imminent or disruptive-action states as structured non-PASS/alerts, but never Set, Reset, Stop, clear flags or change host power from this read case.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1002, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 1003 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 1003 / variant 7339534cafad160e.

IPMI v2.0 section 27.7 defines eight response payload bytes after completion: Timer Use, Timer Actions, pre-timeout interval, expiration flags, two-byte initial countdown and two-byte present countdown.

The standard defines running/logging/use, pre-timeout interrupt, timeout action and flag masks, requires reserved values to be rejected, and stores countdowns little-endian at 100 ms per count. The source's Bytes 2-5 remain intact while the omitted countdown fields are necessary supplemental safety evidence.

Pinned ipmitool maps standard uses/interrupts/actions and converts both countdown words from little-endian to seconds. High-level output can corroborate but raw completion, length, reserved-bit and field evidence remain mandatory.

ED-03, ED-15 through ED-19, ED-22, ED-24 and ED-28 preserve exact raw coverage and evidence; ED-33, ED-34, ED-36 and ED-38 allow fully automated read-only policy comparison and prohibit any corrective write or retry.

test_case.test_name: Read and validate the complete in-band IPMI watchdog state
test_case.purpose: Provide a complete, deterministic snapshot of the intended BMC's watchdog configuration, expiration history and live countdown, compare it to the approved policy and expose imminent/disruptive states without changing watchdog, logs or host state.
required_package: Immutable DUT/BMC/local-IPMI-device mapping, approved in-band interface/privilege and pinned ipmitool/parser/Script
Versioned strict parser requiring completion 00 and exactly eight payload bytes, with reserved-bit/value validation and standard use/interrupt/action/flag masks
Little-endian initial/present countdown decoder using 100 ms units and timestamp/collection-latency metadata
Approved watchdog policy for expected running/logging/use, action, pre-timeout, allowed expiration flags, initial countdown and warning/critical present-count thresholds
Protected local or verified secret-safe access, redaction-aware evidence store and alert routing that cannot invoke control commands
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY AUTOMATION ONLY; DO NOT RUN DURING REVIEW. Bind the exact DUT/BMC/local IPMI device, preserve logs and invoke the pinned equivalent of `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x25` exactly once with a bounded timeout. Capture tool/transport status and IPMI completion separately; require completion 00 and exactly eight payload bytes. Decode Timer Use including running/logging and use, Timer Actions including pre-timeout interrupt and timeout action, pre-timeout seconds, every expiration flag, little-endian initial countdown and present countdown in 100 ms units; reject all reserved bits/encodings. Compare every field to the approved Project policy and calculate present-count safety status using timestamp/latency. Return structured PASS/non-PASS and urgent alert evidence as applicable. Do not clear logs/flags, use high-level text as sole evidence, call Set 0x24 or Reset 0x22, stop the timer, power/reset the host or retry automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The single verified query completes successfully and returns exactly eight well-formed payload bytes. Every field decodes unambiguously, reserved bits are zero, countdown units/order are correct, and the complete watchdog state matches the approved Project policy without an unapproved imminent action or expiration flag. No mutation occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact target, one raw 0x06/0x25 request, completion 00, exact eight-byte payload, valid standard decode and match of every Project-required field including initial/present countdown and permitted flags. Command success, only the four source-listed bytes, high-level text alone, reserved/unknown values, policy mismatch, disallowed expiration history or an armed/imminent unapproved disruptive action cannot pass. Missing policy is NOT READY rather than Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Allow only read-only App NetFn 0x06 command 0x25 on the verified local IPMI device; deny Set, Reset, Stop, host power/reset and arbitrary raw commands.
Interpret `(IB)` from localhost as in-band, not InfiniBand, and verify DUT-to-BMC mapping before collection.
Preserve watchdog/SEL/host logs and expiration flags; do not perform the generic source log clear or clear flags to improve the result.
Use protected local/verified access; prohibit sshpass, plaintext credentials and host-key bypass.
If a countdown is imminent or an action is unsafe, emit an urgent alert and stop; do not issue a compensating write or automatic retry from this case.
Fail closed on timeout, nonzero completion, wrong length, reserved bits/values, parse ambiguity or stale policy.
expected_evidence: DUT asset/serial, intended BMC/local interface and pinned firmware/tool/parser/Script/policy versions
Timestamp, collection latency, tool/transport status, IPMI completion and exact ordered eight-byte payload
Full decoded running/logging/use, interrupt/action, pre-timeout and expiration flags with reserved-bit checks
Initial/present countdown raw words, endian/unit conversion and warning/critical time calculation
Field-by-field policy comparison, alert status, no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit and automated result with engineer verdict ownership
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On malformed, mismatched or imminent output, preserve the exact snapshot, raise the Project-defined alert and close the session. Any Set/Reset/Stop or host recovery belongs to a separately approved incident procedure; this case never changes the timer or repeats the query automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The Master raw command and listed first four fields align with IPMI. Adding the normative countdown fields completes safety evidence without replacing or contradicting source coverage.
